description: This file appears to be a PHP source code file for a controller class within the OpenCart framework, specifically handling customer groups in the admin panel. It includes several methods for listing, viewing, editing, creating, saving, and deleting customer groups, with associated logic for handling requests, permissions, and rendering views.

classes.name: CustomerGroup
classes.description: Controller class for managing customer groups within the OpenCart admin interface. Provides methods for listing, creating, editing, saving, and deleting customer groups, with appropriate permissions and view rendering.

methods.description: Returns the list of customer groups in JSON or formatted output.
